title: Rainbow Springs Clear Kayak and Paddleboard Guided Tours
includes: Kayaks, Life vests, paddles, and dry bags.
Park entry fee. $10.75 per person (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We have BRAND NEW CRYSTAL CLEAR KAYAKS And BRAND NEW SCUBA MASKS that make your adventure the highest quality. We have very educated and experienced guides that have all safety training required to make sure everyone is able to make incredible memories. We offer free photography and lift all equipment for the guests so no one has to tire themselves out before the paddle.
